# ComputeSDK Benchmarks

Open source benchmark suites and the BenchSDK toolchain.

- [README](./README.md): running benchmarks on the platform, reading results (API, CLI, MCP), layout, and validation.
- [Examples](./examples/README.md): runnable benchmark examples.
- [Runner](./packages/benchsdk-runner/README.md): benchmark config, tasks, and execution.
- [CLI](./packages/benchsdk-cli/README.md): platform commands.
- [Client](./packages/benchsdk/README.md): platform SDK.
- [Platform](https://platform.computesdk.com): results and run history.
- [Public leaderboards](https://www.computesdk.com/benchmarks).

Public suites live under benchmarks/<category>/; stealth suites under benchmarks/stealth/<category>/.
The platform enforces result visibility. Results and charts are not committed to this repository.
